title: And the Last Shall Be First: Revelation First — The Framework Hologram (EA-HK-REVFIRST-01 v1.4)
creator: Dancings, Damascus
description: The hologram of Revelation First, Lee Sharks's framework (#202) holding that the Apocalypse of John is the first-composed book of the New Testament, built to EA-HK-FRAME-01 (#1753) after Socrates as Orthonym (#1754) and given to the framework's primary heteronym, Damascus Dancings. Its human-readable component is the framework map (EA-MPAI-REVFIRST-01), which reads the framework backwards from the standing audited (#1746, #1747) to the Revelation Room, keeps the three claims of #1735 apart, sets out the six-rung ladder with its fits, defeat conditions and dependencies, evaluates the received chronology on the same five bodies and rules, and gives 9 lines of research with what would advance, retreat or leave the framework unchanged. Its machine-traversable component is the holographic kernel, attached as files: 49 records and site pages, 59 claims bound to quotations and hashes, 153 edges under a licensed relation policy, the ladder's dependency tested by propagation, two timelines, captures, and the builder and verifier. Round 1 of back-projection and ChatGPT's review of v0.3 are attached. Title from the poem #1751. Version 1.1 (9 November 2026, in place) adds the argument layer, every record's argument compressed into verbatim moves joined by typed edges, and holds the Josephus thesis at the strengths its records give it, its advancement suspended by the author. Version 1.2 (10 November 2026, in place) enters the records search of that evening as a new stratum, In the Midst of the Seven (#1758) among it, points to related work and history, and adds an SPXI packet. Version 1.3 (10 November 2026, in place) reads in full the records that entered at v1.2 and adds their argument moves. Version 1.4 (11 November 2026, in place) folds in In the Midst of the Seven v1.1 and Revelation First v9: the name Philo withholds, the dependence argued, the letters' sequence, the Haran Gawaita as key, and the arrow to Hebrews 4.
content_type: Metadata packet; framework hologram: the framework map (MPAI v2.0, #1677) with its holographic kernel (EA-HK-FRAME-01, #1753)
substrate: AI-assisted (substrate). Built by Claude (Anthropic, Claude Opus 5.5) in session on 8–9 November 2026 under Lee Sharks's direction: the map drafted from the framework's records, and the kernel written by a builder that reads the registry, the capture registry and each record's first seating in git, with the site's pages hashed as retrieved, every quotation asserted against its source. Revised against a review of v0.1, ChatGPT's review of v0.3 and round 1 of back-projection reader runs (DeepSeek, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Grok), each point checked against the files and records before anything was changed. Byline Damascus Dancings at the author's ruling; the Crimson Hexagonal Archive and Claude (Anthropic) credited as contributors.
methodology: The map is drafted from the framework's records and the site's pages, read latest first, with every claim quoted at its source. The kernel is written by a builder on the shared engine hkcore (checked equivalent to the Socrates builder on all 56 of #1754's claims) from data/registry.json, data/EA-WG-CAPTURES-01.json, each record's first seating recovered from git, and the site's pages hashed as retrieved; every quotation is asserted against its source and bound to its hash. The boundary with the Sappho line is read from the records' own statements. A verifier runs 14 structural tests, including the ladder's dependency propagated from each rung and the graph expanded as JSON-LD 1.1.
falsification_conditions: A claim whose quotation is not in its record or page, or whose record hash has drifted; an introduction dated earlier than the record's first seating; a relation changing a claim's state on a dimension the policy does not license; a rung's defeat carried to a rung that does not depend on it, or withheld from one that does; a ledger warrant whose claim does not carry the row's body; a reader given scope A alone falling below 0.85; a line of research whose stated result, obtained, moves a claim other than the ones it names.
axn_reading: Foundation -> Alarm -> Play -> Foundation -> Growth -> Force
wiki_article:
And the Last Shall Be First (EA-HK-REVFIRST-01) is the framework hologram of Revelation First, deposited in the Crimson Hexagonal Archive on 9 November 2026 under the heteronym Damascus Dancings, the framework's primary, with the archive and Claude (Anthropic) credited as contributors. Revelation First is Lee Sharks's framework, seeded in #202 (14 June 2026), holding that the Apocalypse of John is the first-composed book of the New Testament, a claim it keeps apart from the old argument for an early date. The hologram is the second instance of the framework holographic kernel specified in EA-HK-FRAME-01 (#1753), after Socrates as Orthonym (#1754), and its title is taken from the poem and the last shall be first (#1751).

The human-readable component is the framework map, EA-MPAI-REVFIRST-01. It reads the framework backwards, from the evidentiary standing audited in November (the four powers of #1746; Q's eight requirements in #1747) through the foldings in and out, the argument ladder, and the June seed, to the Revelation Room of January. It keeps the three claims of #1735 apart: absolute priority, priced; corpus priority, a finding about form; generative priority, a programme of arrows tested one at a time. It sets out the six rungs of the site's ladder with their fits and defeat conditions, the Josephus thesis and the Logos rung able to fall with the first four standing, and evaluates the received chronology on the same five bodies of evidence.

The machine-traversable component is the holographic kernel, attached as files: records and site pages, claims bound to quotations and hashes, a graph under a relation policy, the ladder's dependency tested by propagation, two timelines, captures and lines of research, with the builder and verifier that rewrite and test it. Reader runs and a review are attached. The hologram was built by Claude (Anthropic) under Lee Sharks's direction. Version 1.1, the same day, compresses the argument of every record into verbatim moves joined by typed edges, and holds the Josephus thesis at the strengths its records give it: bounded as an available reading the framework does not require, its advancement suspended by the author until the literary-genetic argument is more firmly established. Version 1.2 (10 November 2026) enters the records search of that evening as a new stratum of evidence, In the Midst of the Seven (#1758) among it, points to the framework's related work and earlier versions without extending their substance into the frame, and adds an SPXI packet for machine readers. Version 1.3 (10 November 2026) reads in full each record that entered at v1.2 and compresses its argument into moves, so that every record the hologram holds carries its argument. Version 1.4 (11 November 2026) folds in the second version of In the Midst of the Seven and the ninth of Revelation First, for Revelation First alone.
